eligibility: Be a national of a country that receives official development assistance from the OECD Development Assistance Committee
Be from a low-income country and be unable, for political or financial reasons or because suitable educational facilities do not exist, to study for a degree in their own country
Be a new undergraduate student (first year of study)
Apply to a subject in the course listing except medicine
Have received an offer of a place at Oxford - the University cannot consider scholarship applications from students without an offer
Be of the highest academic ability, with financial need, social commitment and inability to study at home all major criteria
Intend to return to their country following their studies
Priority is given to students who have not studied at undergraduate level before
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to nationals of countries that receive official development assistance from the OECD Development Assistance Committee, applying as a new undergraduate student to any subject except medicine. Applicants must already hold an offer of a place at Oxford, must be of the highest academic ability, and should intend to return to their country after their studies.
benefits: One return air fare per year
Three or four years of support depending on course length
Around two to three awards made each year
coverage: One return air fare per year
requirements: Apply for admission to the University and secure an offer before the scholarship can be considered
Apply by the 26 January 2027 scholarship deadline for 2027 entry
Wait for the 2027 entry application details, which will be published on the official page in January 2027
Expect selection to be undertaken in April 2027
Note that the University can only consider an application for undergraduate scholarships once
documents: Oxford undergraduate application and subsequent offer of a place
Evidence of financial need and of inability to study for a degree in their own country
Evidence of social commitment and academic ability
Any supporting documents listed when 2027 entry details are published in January 2027
application_method: Oxford undergraduate application followed by a separate scholarship application published on the official page in January 2027
existing.selection_notes: The scheme 'is only suitable for candidates who have received an offer and who are of the highest academic ability. Financial need, social commitment and lack of ability to study for a degree in their own country are also major criteria for selection.' Applicants should intend to return to their country, and priority is given to students who have not studied at undergraduate level before. Competition is very high and the University has no additional funding for unsuccessful candidates.
existing.best_fit: New undergraduate students from DAC aid-recipient countries who hold an Oxford offer, have the highest academic ability, have demonstrable financial need and social commitment, and cannot study for a degree in their own country.
existing.notes: No monetary figure is published; the official page describes the value as course fees, a living costs grant and one return air fare per year. Around 2-3 awards are made per year, so competition is very high. Applicants who hold a deferred Oxford offer should apply for the scholarship in January of the year they start, and can only be considered once. Foundation Year students should apply in the January of the year they begin their undergraduate degree.
existing.duration: 3 or 4 years depending on course length
existing.application_period: 2026 entry applications are closed. Details for 2027 entry will be published on the official page in January 2027, with a scholarship deadline of 26 January 2027, selection in April 2027 and outcomes communicated by the end of May 2027.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for 2026 entry are now closed. Details on how to apply for 2027 entry will be made available on this page in January 2027; for 2027 entry applicants who apply by the 26 January 2027 scholarship deadline, selection takes place in April 2027.
existing.program_type: Undergraduate bursary for candidates from low-income countries who cannot study for a degree in their own country
